## Today’s learning {#fv5-objective .fv-lesson .intersection-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="objective"><h3>Lesson objective</h3><p>We are learning to determine how lines meet in two and three dimensions.</p><h3>Success criteria</h3><p>I can justify whether two vector lines intersect and find their common point when it exists.</p></div>
```

::: {.notes}
Read briefly. The core idea is equality of position vectors, $\underset{\sim}{r_1}(s)=\underset{\sim}{r_2}(t)$, with independent parameters for the two lines.
:::
